CHAPTER.VERS: We praise you, God, we praise you:we would call on your name and declare your wonders.
“At the time I choose,I will judge fairly.

Though earth melt and all her inhabitants,it is I who keep steady her pillars.” (Selah) I say to the boasters, “Boast not “;to the wicked, “Lift not up your horn:lift not your horn on high,speak not boldly against the Rock.”
For not from east nor west,not from desert nor mountains;but God himself is the judge,humbling one and exalting another.
In the hand of the is a cupfoaming wine, richly spiced.Out of this he pours a draught,and all the wicked of earthmust drain it down to the dregs.
But I will rejoice forever,singing praise to the God of Jacob.
I will hew all the horns of the wicked,but the horns of the just shall be lifted.
